title: Slip on oil-contaminated deck at crane pedestal
summary: Deck rating fell on oil-contaminated deck beside crane pedestal; fractured wrist. Leak had been noticed for weeks.
precursors: recurring hydraulic oil leak at crane pedestal
no drip tray or absorbent at pedestal

title: Accommodation ladder collapse after fall wire parted
